description: Fall asleep, 1 minute timer, brightness 60. A timer change at 30 s holds the factor 600 and fades it down; the timer set back at 30.1 s does not turn it back: the fade-down reaches 120 at 30.5 s and the effect starts again on the countdown from 30.1 s (factor 988 at 31 s, 986.67 at 31.1 s).
